It’s a practical step—not a substitute for adult supervision.
variants.headline: Guidance for Getting Started

variants.primary_text: Looking for a childproofing kit with support? The Peach Bucket’s six-part kit is listed at ₹3,299, with ₹299 savings on prepaid orders. It includes edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards. The offer also includes a 30-day money-back guarantee and 720-day eligible-failure replacement guarantee. Adult supervision remains necessary.
